text:
deploy-bot: [AUTO] Canary deployment blocked: vulnerability scan found HIGH severity in transitive dep 'libvetor@2.1.0' referenced in SBOM for image gcr.io/redwood/llm-service:2026-03-15-canary. CVE-2026-0501. Quarantine initiated.

alex_infra: saw the alert, is it in runtime path or build-time only?

maria_security: quick triage: it affects optional GPU-op plugin not loaded by default; but license metadata is missing signature. Need legal signoff for exception or we pin and rebuild without plugin. :thinking_face:

janet_release: canary is at ~15% in EU only. If we block globally that's rough. Can we quarantine just EU region?

devops_tony: deploy-bot can quarantine by region. Proposal: pause EU canary, continue NA/APAC. Roll EU back to previous image `gcr.io/redwood/llm-service:2026-03-08-stable`.

maria_security: +1 to region-scoped quarantine. I'll start legal ping and prepare rollback playbook. Also add an automatic fallback policy in case health checks fail.

alex_infra: action items: 1) run `snyk test --file=sbom.json` on the canary image, 2) build pinned artifact without gpu-plugin: `./build.sh --exclude gpu-plugin --tag canary-no-gpu`, 3) update release notes with CVE and mitigation. I'll take 1+2 now.

janet_release: updating release notes draft: "Canary paused in EU due to third-party dependency advisory (CVE-2026-0501). Investigating; limited rollback applied to EU canary. No production-wide rollback at this time"

security-bot: Legal review requested: @legal_team (cc @legal_sam) please review license-signature gap for libvetor. Link: https://vendor.example.com/libvetor/2.1.0/notice

legal_sam: on it, should have a preliminary read in ~2h. If signature absent we usually require either vendor attestation or a pin+attest from our side or remove the dependency.

devops_tony: temporary play: if infra confirms runtime safe = false, I'll run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/llm-service -n eu` to restore stable. Standby for green from alex_infra.

deploy-bot: EU canary paused. Rollback scheduled in 10m unless a "no-op" confirmation is posted. (reason: CVE-2026-0501, unsigned SBOM entry).

maria_security: tagging followups: 1) alert QA to run smoke test on `canary-no-gpu`, 2) add an evaluation case to Redwood Optimize evals harness for this CVE surface.

alex_infra: `snyk` output: shows vector affects optional plugin only, exploitability low in our config, but license signature missing is policy violation. Uploading full scan to the thread: (link omitted).

janet_release: ok we will: pause EU, run pinned build, let legal weigh in. If legal approves attestation, we can re-enable EU canary with attestation artifact. Keeping release notes live.

legal_sam: preliminary: vendor claims signature via external keyring; asking them for signed SBOM or we proceed with pin+attest. ETA 1.5h for final.

maria_security: thanks. If legal delays, plan is: EU rollback -> publish patch build without plugin -> limited re-rollout behind canary gating and additional smoke tests.

devops_tony: prepping rollback now, will report back in 6m.

deploy-bot: Rollback executed for EU canary to gcr.io/redwood/llm-service:2026-03-08-stable. Notify @janet_release to update rollout dashboard. :white_check_mark:
